long_description:
SparkGift is a Y Combinator backed technology startup that makes it easy to give investments as gifts.  

The founders came together with a common vision that it should be as easy to give someone an investment in the future, as it is to give someone a retail gift card.  SparkGift supports small dollar gifts and fractional shares, so you can give someone a $20 investment in Apple or a Vanguard index fund.

SparkGift is creating products that make investing simple, enjoyable and accessible to the masses.  Our mission is to use gifts to create new savers & investors at scale.
name: SparkGift

long_description:
Multiplier helps institutional investors research stocks and manage their portfolios. We're live with six hedge funds, and our users spend 4+ hours a day in the platform.

Investors who try "nearly every tool on the market," to quote a client of ours, "wind up with an unwieldy collection of fragmented point solutions." Those who focus on building a great setup with general agents are instead "signing up for a full-time job." So we deploy a platform called Multiplier that unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI work, human work, and tacit firm knowledge in one secure, governed, customized application.

Our first vertical: independent equity funds with $250M-$5B of assets. They know AI is essential for staying relevant, but they don't have the time or talent to figure out what to do about it. But once we deploy Multiplier––"We used to spend 80% of our time gathering information and 20% of our time acting on it," said one customer. "Multiplier has flipped those percentages."
name: Multiplier

long_description:
Financial Datasets is the largest search index for stock market data, built for AI agents.

We index the world's markets so agents can search every filing, answer any financial question, and monitor markets in real time.

For 40 years, market data was built for humans reading a screen. We are rebuilding it for agents that research every company, all day, across the world.
name: Financial Datasets
one_liner: Connect your agents to the stock market
